items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I remember Allan Reuss... But we used to record almost every day.

ctx.x: And he was a real Jazz buff, or fan as they say now. But he loved us all. I remember Allan Reuss, Zutty Singleton and Barney Bigard and Barney Kessel. But we used to record almost every day. We'd all get through work
